01 — Challenge

The Challenge

Kaapi Machines had strong SEO visibility and deep content — but the front-end experience did not match the scale or credibility of their catalog. Browsing was slow, unstructured, and difficult to navigate across a large product range.

Design & Layout Issues

  • Outdated visual presentation across key page templates
  • Product archive lacked structured browsing logic for a large catalog
  • Product cards were basic and not optimised for comparison-style browsing
  • Event-related content had no visual structure or hierarchy

Navigation & Filtering Limitations

  • No advanced filtering experience for a catalog of this size
  • Archive browsing required multiple full page reloads
  • Limited interaction feedback during filtering — poor perceived performance

Content Structure Challenges

  • Kaapi Machines contained 100+ pages with no visual grouping
  • Content-heavy pages lacked design consistency across templates
  • User journey across sections was not clearly guided or connected
02 — Approach

Our Approach

We redesigned the full front-end experience while carefully preserving the site's existing SEO structure and content depth. Every design decision was made to improve usability without disrupting what was already working.

Store & Archive Design

  • Redesigned full product archive layout for structured catalog browsing
  • Implemented AJAX-based filtering — no full page reloads during exploration
  • Improved product card layout with comparison-friendly structure
  • Created a browsing flow suited to B2B buyers evaluating multiple products

Product Page Design

  • Designed structured product detail layouts with clear specification hierarchy
  • Improved visual clarity of product attributes and technical information
  • Enhanced call-to-action placement for better conversion signalling
  • Ensured layout consistency across all product detail templates

Events Section Design

  • Designed dedicated events listing layout with clear content structure
  • Implemented AJAX filtering for events — by type, date, and category
  • Improved event discovery flow and content presentation hierarchy

Community Section Design

  • Designed a scalable layout architecture supporting 100+ pages
  • Created consistent visual templates across all community content types
  • Improved readability across long-form and content-heavy pages
  • Organised content grouping for faster, more intuitive navigation
03 — Results

The Results

The redesigned experience significantly improved usability across a large and complex catalog — without disturbing the SEO performance the client had built over time.

User Experience Improvements

  • Improved browsing clarity across the full product catalog
  • Faster product discovery through AJAX filtering — no reload friction
  • More structured product comparison experience for B2B buyers
  • Improved readability and consistency across content-heavy sections

Design & Usability Impact

  • Stronger visual consistency maintained across all site sections
  • Better structured navigation pathways from discovery to product detail
  • Reduced friction during product exploration and catalog browsing
  • Improved scalability — design system supports future content growth
